sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Open-Market Brokerage of Solid-State Drives and Server Processors

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Domestic Non-Resident Business Corporation Register)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived common law, statutory corporate law, and customary law limited to land matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (Economic Relations Agreement, 1986/2003 Amendments)
Intergovernmental Agreement under FATCA between RMI and the United States of America (effective 2014)
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty with major trading partners currently in force; investment covered by negotiated contractual terms

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 50, RMI Code), as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2022; Maritime and other AML regulations; FIU Directives issued under the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; associated FATF/APG mutual evaluation recommendations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent) and Certificate of Good Standing of foreign parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the parent entity's incorporation jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI is a Contracting State); consular legalization if the issuing state is not an apostille member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Charter of foreign parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; certified English translation required if original is not in English

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Register of Directors and Shareholders / Beneficial Ownership Ledger
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign parent entity or its issuer of corporate records
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; corroborated by due diligence questionnaire

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO identification and verification package (passport, proof of residence, source of funds narrative, and ownership diagram)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; biometric verification may be required by the RMI registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the RMI registered agent and, where applicable, nominee directors; corporate resolutions of the board approving incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate body of the foreign parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; notarization of signatory capacity required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and material attributable trade counterparties against the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and the RMI domestic financial sanctions and counter-proliferation lists. PEP status is determined under FATF 40 Recommendations; specific and enhanced due diligence applying to politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates. For a medium-risk semiconductor wholesale entity engaged in cross-border Swift/TT and escrow wires, enhanced continuous monitoring, negative news screening, and transaction-triggered PEP re-screening are required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations – Online Name Clearance and Reservation Facility (administered under the Business Corporations Act, Title 50 of the RMI Code; accessible via the RMI Corporate Registry ePortal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Latin-alphabet English. Marshallese-language names are permitted only if transliterated into Latin characters with a certified English translation. Suffixes allowed include 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd.', 'Corp.', or 'Inc.'. No other corporate suffix is permitted for a Business Corporation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any foreign country name if misleading
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30-day period upon written application and payment of the extension fee before the original expiry. If the Registrar rejects a requested name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Chief Registrar within 14 days of the written rejection. The appeal must include the original reservation application, the refusal notice, proposed amended name (if any), and a USD 100 appeals filing fee. The Chief Registrar shall issue a binding determination within 15 business days. Judicial review is available before the High Court of the Marshall Islands for abuse of discretion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a non-resident open-market wholesale brokerage entity provided that the entity maintains a registered office in Majuro through a licensed RMI registered agent. The registered agent's physical street address is used for legal service and authority mailing; no physical trading premises in RMI are required. A virtual office arrangement on the registered agent's premises is acceptable as long as the agent's address is disclosed and the non-resident exempt tax status is preserved.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: Unannounced on-site physical inspection of the entity's own premises: less than 5% within the first 12 months absent local operations or adverse intelligence. Inspection of the registered agent's office and file records where the entity is registered: 40% likelihood over the same period, given RMI's commitment to FATF compliance. Desk-based review of business substance and beneficial ownership records: 65% expected rate.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and authentication processing of UBO bundle (5 documents at USD 45 per document)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Notary Public / Ministry of Foreign Affairs or issuing authority in foreign jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official authentication fee plus courier out-of-pocket not included

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee (authorized capital not exceeding USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee under Business Corporations Act, Title 50 RMI Code

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office retainer (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for non-resident business corporation maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO and AML/CFT onboarding and KYC compliance review (including PEP and sanctions screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated compliance officer of the RMI registered agent / FIU reporting intermediary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market standard compliance fee under RMI AML/CFT Act obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Flat professional fee for pre-incorporation legal documentation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-scope professional fee based on initial due diligence and risk rating

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, digital archives, and contingency processing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Marshall Islands Revised Code, Title 27, §§ 105–110 (Articles of Incorporation, Registered Agent, and Registered Office)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; shares may be issued at such time and for such consideration as the Board determines. No escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board approves the share subscription per the subscriptions presented and directs the CFO to issue shares against payment. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be the address of the Registered Agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the Registered Agent is authorized to accept service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following officers are appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until successors are elected. The officers are authorized to execute all documents and open bank accounts to complete the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Name Reservation Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Marshall Islands-licensed registered agent, execute the agent consent, and file a name reservation request via the online portal to reserve the proposed corporate name for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Identification of the proposed corporation's incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, the Registry will suggest alternatives; file an amended reservation with a new name within the same SLA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – E-Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in the registry-prescribed form, including number of authorized shares, registered office address, and registered agent. Execute before a notary and upload the scanned documents to the e-filing portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected for defect, correct the noted clerical item and resubmit within 5 business days; expedited review is available for immediate refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay State Filing Fees and Capital Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Office – Integrated Payment Gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Remit the prescribed state incorporation fee and any expedited fees via the online payment module using the transaction ID generated by the registry. Retain the payment receipt as evidence of tender.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the payment is not automatically matched to the filing, submit the payment receipt to the registry cashier for manual reconciliation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive Certificate of Incorporation and Approved Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Issuance Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the filing is recorded, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. Review all details including company number, name, date of incorporation, and authorized shares, and correct any registry transcription errors within 10 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains errors, submit a 'Certificate of Correction' form with the original certificate for reissue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Setup and Registered Office Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Compliance and Agent Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to adopt bylaws, accept initial subscriptions, appoint officers, and issue shares. File a confirmation of registered office / registered agent notice if the agent has changed since incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office notice is rejected, correct the address or agent details and refile.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Natural Resources and Commerce – not applicable for pure wholesale; no sectoral license imposed on IT hardware brokerage
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required – Wholesale Distribution of IT Hardware (Non-Physical, Non-Hazardous Commercial Activity)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical manufacturing or pollutant discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; business does not generate wastewater, VOCs, or hazardous waste streams. No effluent or emission permits necessary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for office-only brokerage operations. If optional warehousing is used, annual fire safety inspection and commercial building occupancy clearance from Majuro Municipality are recommended.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs (MIRC), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; online portal: https://mirc.gov.mh
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Business Corporation registered in the Marshall Islands obtains a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by filing TIN-01 with MIRC together with a certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, registered agent address, and non-resident status declaration. MIRC issues the TIN on the same day; no VAT ID is required or available because the jurisdiction does not operate a VAT/GST regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A Marshall Islands Business Corporation may elect 'Non-Resident Business Corporation' status under the Business Corporations Act, thereby confirming exemption from all Marshall Islands taxes on foreign-source income and international trading activities. No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under domestic law; the entity's tax exemption is treaty-independent and self-executing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax; indirect taxation is limited to customs duties and excise taxes under the Customs and Excise Act 2015
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; no VAT/GST registration threshold exists in the Marshall Islands. Any importer or exporter must register with MIRC for customs purposes, regardless of turnover; the currency of account is the United States Dollar (USD).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The Marshall Islands does not mandate electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping. MIRC operates ASYCUDA World for electronic customs declarations, but exports are assessed on a paper or electronic manifest; there is no continuous transaction control (CTC) requirement or fiscal API protocol.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands has no VAT/GST system, so there is no 'zero rate' or refundable input-tax mechanism. Offshore sales of SSD/CPU chips and related services by a Non-Resident Business Corporation are entirely outside the Marshall Islands indirect tax base; no zero-rating claim is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because there is no VAT zero-rating or refund regime, there is no statutory clawback of input tax credits. Fraudulent export exemption claims or material misdeclarations are prosecuted under the Customs and Excise Act 2015: monetary penalties up to USD 50,000, imprisonment up to five years, and an additional assessment equal to three times the duty evaded; habitual offenders may be suspended from MIRC-facilitated trade privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The RMI does not maintain a domestic central bank or a separate foreign-exchange administration; monetary and currency functions are effectively discharged by the Board of Governors of the U.S. Federal Reserve System pursuant to the Compact of Free Association, because the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender. Banking licensing, prudential supervision, and residual exchange-administration powers are vested in the Banking Commissioner under the Financial Institutions Act 2011, supported by AML/CFT suspicious-transaction oversight from the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; the Banking Commissioner also licenses and supervises remittance agents and escrow agents engaged in trade clearing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility exists for both current-account and capital-account transactions because the RMI has no domestic currency and no foreign-exchange statute. There are no exchange controls, no approval gates, no surrender requirements, and no withholding or exit levies on dividends, profit remittances, repayment of shareholder loans, or repatriation of contributed capital for a non-resident-owned Business Corporation. The practical hurdles are private-bank-driven: U.S. correspondent banks apply OFAC SDN/SSI screening, FATF high-risk jurisdiction filtering, and enhanced-source-of-wealth review on inflows originating in sanctions-exposed corridors; accordingly, any remittance of trading profits should be supported by audited financial statements, trade invoices, and ECCN classification memoranda for the underlying SSDs and server processors to pre-empt frozen wires or compliance holds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI law imposes no statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or export-receipts surrender obligation; a non-resident Business Corporation may retain, net, or deploy export proceeds in U.S. dollars indefinitely, whether onshore or offshore. As a clearing-layer practice only, RMI-licensed banks apply a three-to-five-business-day funds-availability hold on incoming SWIFT MT103 export proceeds pending OFAC screening and beneficiary string-matching, and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit expects contemporaneous proof of the underlying trade (invoice, bill of lading, packing list) for any USD transaction above the customer-due-diligence reporting threshold. No RMI government approval or conversion certificate is required at any time.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Majuro Branch (FDIC-insured U.S. institution)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. The RMI has no domestic EMI or digital-bank licensing framework, and major offshore EMI/fintech platforms (e.g., Mercury, Wise Business, Currencycloud, Payoneer) generally decline onboarding of a non-resident RMI Business Corporation because the jurisdiction is treated as a higher-risk offshore shell-vehicle jurisdiction in correspondent-bank risk models and lacks a central-bank reciprocity or licensing passport on which EMIs can rely. A workable alternative is to route the operating cash flow through the RMI BC's U.S. or Hong Kong trading hub (with physical substance) and use that hub's EMI account only for customer collections, while the RMI BC maintains its statutory treasury on tier-1 bank accounts; the RMI Banking Commissioner can license a money transmitter for non-deposit-taking payment pass-through, but that does not reproduce deposit-taking or escrow-inspection capabilities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is strongly preferred and is effectively mandatory for the first account at any RMI-licensed bank unless a formal remote-onboarding-with-enhanced-due-diligence exception is approved by the bank's compliance committee. The standard requirement is that at least one authorized signatory (director) and every 10%-or-greater UBO appear in person at the Majuro or Ebeye branch, or alternatively complete a live encrypted video KYC interview with notarized identity documents, professional referee letters, and a certified copy of the corporate resolution granting signature authority. For the non-resident MH_BC, the practical path is video onboarding with certified true-copy passports, apostilled or notarized register of directors, and a pre-cleared escrow and trade counterparty profile; the bank will impose a provisional transaction limit (commonly USD 100,000 per wire until the first independent inspection certificate is received and verified).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer-share legacy risk and opaque beneficial ownership of the non-resident Business Corporation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of good standing from the RMI Registrar of Corporations; certified register of directors, officers, and shareholders; full UBO register filed with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding and that any historic bearer instruments have been canceled and immobilized; a board resolution disclosing the ownership chain to the ultimate natural person; and a notarized source-of-wealth statement for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-risk flag: no physical office, employees, or substance in the RMI combined with a tax-exempt zoning model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI non-resident Business Corporation status certificate and registered-agent agreement; substance explanation memorandum describing the cross-border brokerage model (order matching, margin capture, third-party inspection, risk finalization) and identifying physical substance in the trade corridor, such as a Hong Kong or Singapore bonded logistics hub under a signed warehouse services agreement; lease or address evidence for the principal place of business; group organizational chart and staffing table; expected monthly transaction volume; and a board-approved treasury policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume SSD and server-processor spot trading with split consignments, serialized inventory, and multi-currency invoice discipline.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreement, purchase orders, and proforma invoices per consignment; packing lists and airway bills or bills of lading with serial-number registers for SSD/CPU lots; ECCN classification memoranda (commonly 5A992/Cryptography-Note review for SSDs and 4A994.b for server CPUs) with end-use and end-user attestations and screening against the U.S. Entity List and OFAC SDN; market benchmark price evidence (memory and controller contract rates) to justify invoice values; and a completed transaction-rationale form for each trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual payment patterns: escrow-inspection wires naming third-party escrow agents and multiple disbursement recipients in separate jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed escrow agreement with the named independent escrow agent; independent inspection certificates (SGS/BV-type) referencing inspection report IDs, lot serials, and test results; buyer-signed authorization letter instructing the escrow agent to release funds; SWIFT MT103 field-70 references embedding contract, invoice, and inspection-lot IDs; a pre-approved counterparty and beneficiary whitelist filed with the bank; and a documentary chain pack (commercial invoice, LC, bill of lading, packing list, insurance certificate) retained for an audit trail of at least seven years.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be directed as USD-denominated SWIFT MT103 (with MT202/COV cover leg where required) from a U.S., Hong Kong, Singapore, or EU shareholder-funded clearing bank, using ISO 20022 Purpose Code EQUI (equity investment) and a field-70 remittance reference structured as 'MH_BC CAPITAL INJECTION - SHARE ISSUANCE RESOLUTION [date/no.] - UBO [name]'. The bank's onboarding of the injected funds triggers automatic matching of the UBO register to the remitter screen; deposits above USD 100,000 invoke enhanced due diligence including the capital-introduction letter, board share-issuance resolution, valuation support at par or fair value, and source-of-wealth bank statements. No RMI regulatory approval is required, but the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit suspicious-transaction threshold applies, so the entire value trail must remain documented; funds must not be split into sub-USD 10,000 tranches, as structured-avoidance screening would then freeze the account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements should be ranked by authenticity and control: (1) sight Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700/MT710) with settlement via MT103/MT202 against presentation of the independent inspection certificate, transport documents, and title documents, favoring U.S., Hong Kong, or Singapore issuing banks; (2) SWIFT MT103 GPI single-credit transfers for confirmed supplier payables, always carrying Purpose Code TRAD and contract and inspection-lot references in field 70; (3) escrow-inspection wire releases, where the designated escrow agent disburses against a digitally signed inspection certificate from the locked Capital Escrow Account; and (4) banker's drafts for minor spot purchases. All disbursements must run over U.S., Hong Kong, or Singapore USD clearing corridors, avoid sanctioned-corridor intermediaries, adopt T+1 value dating to allow OFAC post-credit screening, and be reconciled in a standing file that maps each outbound wire to its invoice, inspection certificate, bill of lading, and serial-number register.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forwards (USD versus TWD, KRW, JPY, EUR, or CNH), tenor up to 12 months, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or IFEMA with a U.S., Hong Kong, or Singapore-licensed bank and supported by underlying trade orders.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/CNY (settled against CNH), USD/TWD, and USD/KRW offshore reference rates, permissible where local-currency deliverability is legally or practically restricted.
Cross-currency swaps (USD versus JPY, EUR, or CNH) hedging matched trade-payable and trade-receivable cash-flow streams, including basis-swap funding of inventory financing.

Vanilla FX options, zero-cost collars, and participating-forward structures under the ISDA 1998 FX Definitions with a credit support annex, approved case-by-case by the clearing bank; intercompany netting of matching trade flows is permitted as a cash-management overlay but is not treated as a hedging instrument.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation (combined annual return, representation, and franchise tax declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year filing window January 1 through April 30; per BCA §106, the report is due regardless of incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 100 for each year or part of a year the report is overdue; the corporation is marked not in good standing; failure for two consecutive years allows the Registrar to administratively strike off the corporation (dissolution). Restoration requires a reinstatement petition, full payment of all arrears and penalties, and the filing of a current annual report.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and UBO Schedule Refresh (annual attestation of ultimate beneficial owners of the BC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations through the licensed resident registered agent (confidential Beneficial Ownership Database)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same annual window (January 1 – April 30) as the annual report; additionally, a 30-day update obligation applies after any transfer of shares that changes the UBO schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fee because the UBO confirmation is bundled with the annual report; failure to maintain or lodge the UBO schedule exposes the corporation and its officers to civil penalties under the RMI Beneficial Ownership Regulations, blocks further share transfers and payment-rail settlement, and may prompt the registered agent to resign, causing administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold exists for a private, non-resident Business Corporation. An independent audit is compulsory only if the BC is listed on a recognized securities exchange, its Articles or Bylaws require audited financial statements, or a shareholder demand or court order validly requires one. The wholesale SSD/CPU trading BC with no public listing is outside the mandatory audit regime.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The RMI does not prescribe a mandatory local GAAP for unlisted business corporations. IFRS (IASB) is the accepted standard for audited financial statements; US GAAP is also acceptable for US-connected non-resident entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership data is maintained privately in the Registrar's Beneficial Ownership Database and refreshed through the registered agent with each annual report. Every share transfer must be simultaneously recorded in the Register of Members and the UBO schedule lodged within 30 days of the transfer. The registered agent is obligated to verify the identity of each ultimate beneficial owner before the company may settle wholesale SSD/CPU proceeds or complete any share transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 per year for a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent, inclusive of registered office, annual report preparation, Beneficial Ownership Database filings, and routine corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required for the private BC; if a certified voluntary audit is commissioned for the semiconductor wholesale entity (Swift TT and escrow-inspection payment rails), the typical market fee is USD 6,000 – USD 15,000 per annum depending on transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% flat income tax on Marshall Islands-source corporate income only; 0% effective statutory rate for a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (NRDC) conducting all SSD/CPU wholesale trading outside the Republic
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: NRDC exemption under the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Act 2004: complete exemption from income tax on foreign-source income; no capital gains tax; no net worth or wealth tax; no branch profits or dividend remittance tax; no VAT/GST on offshore trading; a flat annual government maintenance fee replaces income tax administration

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report (Annual Confirmation Statement) required under the Business Corporations Act and the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Act 2004; filed electronically through the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations online registry portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls (per Registrar billing notice); NRDC status must be reaffirmed in each filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert exact legal name and registration number as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address within the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the licensed registered agent's physical office address in Majuro; no business premises in the Republic may be listed for an NRDC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resident agent name and contact details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the appointed Marshall Islands-licensed resident agent and keep the agency agreement in force
List all directors and officers; nominee directors are permissible but the ultimate beneficial owner must be identified for AML purposes
State the capital structure; no minimum paid-up capital is required for the MH_BC entity

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation certification (no income sourced in the Republic; no business carried on within the Republic)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Execute the statutory declaration accurately; a false certification to obtain tax exemption is a criminal offense and triggers loss of NRDC status

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax residence and economic substance self-classification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the foreign jurisdiction of tax residence and confirm subjection to corporate income tax or an equivalent economic substance regime there to remain outside the Marshall Islands ESR scope

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a 10% surcharge on the annual government fee (per Registrar fee schedule); continued default leads to administrative dissolution and loss of limited liability; reinstatement requires payment of all overdue fees, surcharges, and reinstatement charges; the Registrar may deregister the entity after a statutory cure period

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands Corporate Income Tax Return (Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance) - required only if the corporation derives gross income from sources within the Marshall Islands; not applicable to a compliant NRDC with zero Marshall Islands-source income
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing date prescribed by the Revenue and Taxation Division, in practice on or before the last day of the fourth month following the close of the taxable year; extensions may be granted upon written application

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from sources within the Republic
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude all foreign-source SSD/CPU wholesale trading proceeds; include only income with a Marshall Islands situs (e.g., goods or services supplied inside the Republic)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions attributable to Marshall Islands-source income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only ordinary and necessary expenses directly connected with production of the Marshall Islands-source income; no apportionment of foreign trading losses is permitted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income and 3% corporate tax computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 3% flat corporate rate; no foreign tax credits or treaty reductions are available because the Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double tax treaty network

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or pay triggers interest at the statutory rate on unpaid tax, monetary fines for non-filing, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent or false returns; additional penalties apply for understatement attributable to deliberate concealment
